descr: Qwen3.8-Max vs Kimi K3: a close Arena tie, with similar chat scores and distinct free options.
risposta: The two models are about even in the Arena blind vote. Kimi K3 scores 1488, Qwen3.8-Max scores 1484. The difference is too small to declare a clear winner.
dimensioni: Kimi K3 weighs 2779.9 B with 104.6 B active parameters. A 4-bit download requires about 1686 GB. Qwen3.8-Max does not publish its size, so the file footprint is unknown. Both models are listed in the Arena database and have been evaluated by thousands of voters.
velocita: At home hardware, Kimi K3 does not fit the RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RX 7900 XTX, Mac M4 Max 128 GB, or Ryzen AI Max+ 395 128 GB configurations. Qwen3.8-Max also does not fit those same GPUs. The data only shows these GPUs cannot hold the models; it does not state that no other home machine could run them.
gratisA: Kimi K3 can be used for free by downloading the open-weight files and running the model locally. The license permits free use at home. The model cannot be tried directly on the FreeLLMArena try-and-compare page.
gratisB: Qwen3.8-Max offers a free trial quota on Alibaba Cloud for 90 days. The trial runs under a proprietary license. Like Kimi K3, it is not available for direct testing on the FreeLLMArena try-and-compare page.
sceglieA: Pick Kimi K3 if you need an open-weight model you can run on your own hardware. Its chat score is slightly higher than Qwen3.8-Max. The model is suitable for experiments that require full control over the weights.
sceglieB: Pick Qwen3.8-Max if coding performance matters most. It leads Kimi K3 in the coding category with a score of 1675 versus 1658. The free cloud trial makes it easy to test without setting up a local environment.

categorie.Chat: In the chat category Kimi K3 scores 1488 and Qwen3.8-Max scores 1484. The Arena judges consider the results about even.
categorie.Coding: Qwen3.8-Max leads the coding category with a score of 1675, while Kimi K3 scores 1658.
